Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de echipamente medicale
Founded in Munich, Germany in 1989, Brainlab develops, manufactures and markets software-driven medical technology, enabling access to improved, more efficient, less-invasive patient treatments. Our key to success is our creative, talented and hard-working team, which consists of around 2400 dedicated and inspiring individuals in 25 locations worldwide. To succeed in reaching our targets, we are seeking committed colleagues who can stand behind our core values curious, authentic and useful.
 Job Description
 Join our technical support team as a Brainlab Support Specialist. You'll provide expert service, manage installations and maintenance, and support clinical staff—remotely from your home office.
Products: Loop X, Airo. Learn more about Loop X by clicking here .
 Main Responsibilities Will Include
Independently perform installations, maintenance, and repairs of Brainlab systems (e.g. Loop X, Airo) at hospitals and clinical sites
Provide remote and on-site technical support, guiding clinical users through troubleshooting and system operation
Ensure optimal device functionality by conducting diagnostics, upgrades, and proactive service checks
Act as a trusted technical advisor for our customers, fostering strong relationships and long-term satisfaction
Support product launches by coordinating setup, testing, and user onboarding
Document all service activities accurately and in compliance with quality standards
Collaborate closely with other teams (sales, engineering, clinical support) to ensure a seamless customer experience
 Qualifications
Degree in electrical engineering, electronics, mechatronics, or similar
Ideally first experience in technical support, preferably in the healthcare sector
Familiar with X-ray systems and/or scanner technology (a plus)
Strong IT, networking, and troubleshooting skills
Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style
Excellent communication skills in English and German
High willingness to travel national (up to 80%), with the possibility of occasional international assignments
Confident use of MS Office; Salesforce knowledge is an advantage
Valid driver’s licence
 Please submit your CV in English when applying for this position.
Additional Information
A mutually-supportive, international team
Meaningful work with a lasting impact on medical technology
Company car, cell phone, laptop - also for private use
Flexible working hours as well as homeoffice
Comprehensive training and continuing education opportunities
 Ready to apply? We look forward to receiving your online application including your first available start date and desired salary.
